latest_release.name: v4.5.92
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* build(deps): bump rustls from 0.23.45 to 0.23.46 in /rust by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31043
* chore: remove coinex article by @carlosmiei in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31046
* fix(bybit): report the liquidation order side in watchLiquidations by @stooq1 in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31042
* feat(mcp): fetch_route and execute_route over ccxt OrderRouter by @pcriadoperez in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31077
* feat(base): OrderRouter userAgent option by @pcriadoperez in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31076
* fix(coinbaseinternational): TypeError on public/auth in Python, breaking all private calls by @ye-chuan in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31068
* Revert "test: fix static test errors" by @ttodua in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31087
* docs(blog): add CCXT Terminal for iOS launch post by @kroitor in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31088
* docs(blog): add CCXT Terminal for Android launch post by @kroitor in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31089
* docs(blog): replace CCXT Terminal for iOS hero image by @kroitor in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31090
* docs(blog): replace CCXT Terminal for iOS hero image again by @kroitor in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31091
* fix(go): leave liquidation caches nil until a handler creates them by @carlotestor in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31092
* feat(hitbtc): add unWatchTrades and unWatchOHLCV by @patrickballard in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31100
* bybit hardcode fiat currencies by @ndubel in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31096
* fix(bitget): watchOrders reports the cumulative filled and cost by @lcfgr in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31094
* feat(coinbaseinternational): change brokerId to ccxt by @Dan-krm in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31103
* feat(kucoin): orderbook update by @carlosmiei in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31104
* fix(bitget): skip spot instruments without base or quote coin in fetchMarkets by @Welith in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31105
* feat(revolutx): conditional and take profit/stop loss orders by @Mohith26 in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31102
* fix(java): default liquidations cache to null so WS tests stop hanging by @carlosmiei in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31107

## New Contributors
* @lcfgr made their first contribution in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31094
* @Welith made their first contribution in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31105
* @Mohith26 made their first contribution in https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/pull/31102

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/compare/v4.5.91...v4.5.92
